svg.title: Global average pooling: from 5×5×2048 to one vector per image
svg.desc: A batch of 32 images of 150 by 150 by 3 goes into the base model, which outputs a four-dimensional array of 32 by 5 by 5 by 2048. Global average pooling slices each image's 5 by 5 by 2048 output into 2048 squares of 5 by 5, takes the average of each square and puts it into a vector, so the batch becomes 32 by 2048. A dense layer with 10 outputs then gives 32 by 10 predictions.
